svg.title: SVG Image created as RAMS_JLC_S3-02 ESP32-S3 and 2.4 GHz RF.svg date 2026-11-13T17:47:38

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Measure startup, frequency and drive/harmonics; these parts are not tuned yet.

g.desc: Measure startup, frequency and drive/harmonics; these parts are not tuned yet.

g.text: R9 22R damps/limits drive. It differs from Espressif's 24nH starting guidance.

g.desc: R9 22R damps/limits drive. It differs from Espressif's 24nH starting guidance.

g.text: 12pF is an available starting pair; actual stray capacitance is unmeasured.

g.desc: 12pF is an available starting pair; actual stray capacitance is unmeasured.

g.text: Reset release depends on the input threshold and supply ramp, not exactly 10 ms.

g.desc: Reset release depends on the input threshold and supply ramp, not exactly 10 ms.

g.text: Exposed pad 57 is GND and a thermal path; inspect the hidden solder joint.

g.desc: Exposed pad 57 is GND and a thermal path; inspect the hidden solder joint.

g.text: R34 holds GPIO0 high; R35/R36 hold GPIO45/46 low while straps are sampled.

g.desc: R34 holds GPIO0 high; R35/R36 hold GPIO45/46 low while straps are sampled.

g.text: C17/C20 bypass internally supplied VDD_SPI: do not tie it to +3V3. Ideal |XC|=1/(2*pi*f*C); real ESR/ESL and placement matter.

g.desc: C17/C20 bypass internally supplied VDD_SPI: do not tie it to +3V3. Ideal |XC|=1/(2*pi*f*C); real ESR/ESL and placement matter.

g.text: L1 + C11/C12/C13 feed/bypass VDD_RF; C14 supports main rail; C15/C16 serve CPU/RTC; C21/C22 analog supply.

g.desc: L1 + C11/C12/C13 feed/bypass VDD_RF; C14 supports main rail; C15/C16 serve CPU/RTC; C21/C22 analog supply.

g.text: Phone GPS/IMU -> BLE -> U1 -> LoRa. No separate GPS/IMU hardware added.

g.desc: Phone GPS/IMU -> BLE -> U1 -> LoRa. No separate GPS/IMU hardware added.

g.text: 4 MB embedded flash + 2 MB quad PSRAM; initial build leaves PSRAM disabled.

g.desc: 4 MB embedded flash + 2 MB quad PSRAM; initial build leaves PSRAM disabled.

g.text: Buttons on sheet 4: hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT to enter download.

g.desc: Buttons on sheet 4: hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT to enter download.

g.text: GPIO0 BOOT/cancel; 1 buzzer; 2 ADC; 8/9 LoRa interrupt/reset.

g.desc: GPIO0 BOOT/cancel; 1 buzzer; 2 ADC; 8/9 LoRa interrupt/reset.

g.text: CLC: 1.5pF / 2.4nH / 1.5pF. Antenna network: 1.2pF series / 2.7nH shunt / 3.3nH series. ANT1 pin2 is intentionally NC.

g.desc: CLC: 1.5pF / 2.4nH / 1.5pF. Antenna network: 1.2pF series / 2.7nH shunt / 3.3nH series. ANT1 pin2 is intentionally NC.

g.text: At 2.4GHz: XL(2.4nH)=36.2R; |XC|(1.5pF)=44.2R (ideal examples, not proof of a 50R match).

g.desc: At 2.4GHz: XL(2.4nH)=36.2R; |XC|(1.5pF)=44.2R (ideal examples, not proof of a 50R match).

g.text: Tune with actual board/enclosure/body loading. Keep antenna no-metal area clear; LoRa uses a separate 433MHz antenna.

g.desc: Tune with actual board/enclosure/body loading. Keep antenna no-metal area clear; LoRa uses a separate 433MHz antenna.
